title: Let Agents Design How They Search: Automatic Interface Optimization for Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.29250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic search depends on the interface through which a language-model agent accesses and explores a corpus. Existing interface designs are fixed by hand and applied unchanged to every corpus, although effective designs may depend on the corpus. We introduce SearchWeaver, a framework for automatic search interface optimization guided by downstream search performance. A proposer uses execution trajectories and task rewards to jointly revise corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions. This pro cess optimizes what information is prepared in advance, which operations tools perform, and which decisions remain with the search agent. With GPT-5.4-nano, the optimized interfaces improve answer accuracy from 71.6% to 78.4% on BrowseComp-Plus and average nDCG@10 from 45.7 to 55.0 across four BRIGHT subsets over Direct Corpus Interaction. translated_title: 让智能体自行设计搜索方式：面向智能体搜索的自动界面优化
translated_abstract: 智能体搜索依赖于语言模型智能体访问和探索语料库所使用的界面。现有的界面设计均由人工固定，并无差别地应用于每一个语料库，然而有效的设计可能取决于具体的语料库。我们提出了 SearchWeaver，一个以下游搜索性能为指导的自动搜索界面优化框架。提议者利用执行轨迹和任务奖励来联合修订语料库产物、可执行工具和使用说明。这一过程优化了预先准备哪些信息、工具执行哪些操作，以及哪些决策保留给搜索智能体。在使用 GPT-5.4-nano 时，与直接语料库交互相比，优化后的界面在 BrowseComp-Plus 上将答案准确率从 71.6% 提升至 78.4%，并在四个 BRIGHT 子集上将平均 nDCG@10 从 45.7 提升至 55.0。这些发现凸显了联合优化语料库产物、可执行工具与使用说明的价值。
tldr: 提出 SearchWeaver 框架，利用执行轨迹和任务奖励自动联合优化语料库产物、可执行工具和使用说明，使搜索界面随具体语料库自适应优化，显著提升答案准确率与检索排序效果。
en_tdlr: SearchWeaver automatically optimizes agentic search interfaces by jointly revising corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions based on execution trajectories and task rewards, substantially improving answer accuracy and retrieval ranking over fixed hand-designed interfaces.
